rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for one press of a keyboard key.

example.english: One keystroke is enough to bring up the screen.
example.traditional: 撳一下鍵，個畫面就跳咗出嚟。
example.jyutping: gam6 jat1 haa5 gin6 go3 waa2 min2 zau6 tiu3 zo2 ceot1 lai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a keyboard shortcut rather than an individual key press.

example.english: This keystroke lets you save the document instantly.
example.traditional: 按呢個快捷鍵就可以即刻儲存份文件。
example.jyutping: on3 ni1 go3 faai3 zit3 gin6 zau6 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 cyu5 cyun4 fan6 man4 gin6
